effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with as much or less DP as 1 of your [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon.
[All Turns] While you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, all of your [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon gain ＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, all of your Digimon with the [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait gain ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Dark Dragon]/[Evil Dragon] trait: Cost 3
